contentText: STEP Lincoln Modular Switches STEP Lincoln is a modular switch and accessories range from Step Cables. This page lists all 156 Lincoln products from the latest supplied website product data. Product categories include Optimus Switches, Maxtron Switches, 6A/16A Sockets, Communication Accessories, Typhoon Dimmers & Regulators, Support Accessories, LED Foot Light, Motor Starter, Modular MCB, Caspian Dimmers & Regulators, Marsh Cover Plates - Chrome White, Mosaic Cover Plates - Acrylic Black, Mosaic Cover Plates - Acrylic Grey, Mirage Cover Plates - White, Mirage Cover Plates - Black, Mirage Cover Plates - Grey. For price, scheme and packaging changes, use the official PDF in the Downloads section.
